correctness.rationale: Acyclic subsets of the k-terminal-path theta graph are precisely subsets containing at most one full path. Separating proper/full path edge subsets proves (1), and substituting the exact Walsh character sums yields integer multiplier (2). Since every \(2^{\ell}-1\) is -1 modulo four, (4) follows with the correct global sign, proving a nonzero multiplier for all k not congruent 1 mod4. Setting all lengths two and choosing exactly 3(k-1)/4 zero frequency blocks gives a zero for every k congruent 1 mod4. Partitioning by zero blocks proves the exact nullity (5); inequalities prove the five-path criterion; the equal-length divisibility and (6) follow by direct algebra. An independent exact Walsh-Hadamard script checked 284032 frequencies for six cases, but the infinite result relies on this symbolic proof.

value.rationale: The result identifies a structural arithmetic boundary for information loss over every unequal-length generalized theta family, in contrast with merely listing forests or evaluating an ordinary Tutte polynomial. Its modulo-four universality is sharp for every exceptional branch count, and the five-path classification and exact all-parameter nullity make the boundary actionable. Exact inversion/non-inversion is a natural invariant of this convolution rather than an arbitrarily selected low-degree or finite-slice statistic.
